target: UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF, AArch64 PCI graphical guest, one vCPU, VirtIO keyboard and tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-tothefront-current-c161-2026-11-12.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-tothefront
verified: ToTheFront launched through the normal graphical-terminal path, accepted player setup, and rendered its map.
The app accepted phase input, selected artillery, displayed its range, and plotted an order to an adjacent hex.
Escape returned to the graphical terminal; 40+2 evaluated as 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: Focused exact-image automated input and terminal-recovery acceptance; not live UTM UI or physical Pi acceptance.
